briefing.headline: 2 of 4 projects need attention this sprint; Harbor is the steadiest.
briefing.summary: Across 432 tickets, 896 pull requests and 22 repositories, delivery is uneven. Harbor is likely to finish its sprint (99%), while Quasar is 16% done with 58% of the sprint gone. OneView found 59 cross-tool signals — places where JIRA, pull requests and repositories disagree — most often tickets closed before their code was merged.

risks.text: Quasar is expected to finish only 41% of QSR Sprint 58 (22 of 55 points).
Orion: Done in JIRA, but PR #1347 is not merged.
Luna: Done in JIRA, but PR #5158 is not merged.
Harbor: Done in JIRA, but PR #5156 is not merged.

wins.text: Orion is on track at 56% done with no blockers.
Orion 2.20.0 looks safe: predicted 12 days ahead of its 2026-12-12 date.
Luna 6.0.0 looks safe: predicted 85 days ahead of its 2027-02-27 date.

focus.text: Luna: Move LUNA-328 (8 pts) from @mei_demo to @alex_demo.
Quasar: Move QSR-462 (3 pts) from @alex_demo to @sam_demo.

ORION.narrative: Orion is on track: 56% of ORN Sprint 47 is done with 58% of the time used. The forecast expects about 54 of 59 points (91%) by the end of the sprint; completing every point has a 5% chance. The riskiest ticket is ORN-397 (past due date, highest priority). 7 tickets marked Done still have unmerged PRs, so shipped work may be overstated.
ORION.outlook: The sprint goal is unlikely without cutting scope.

LUNA.narrative: Luna is off track: 32% of LUNA Sprint 33 is done with 58% of the time used. The forecast expects about 37 of 62 points (59%) by the end of the sprint; completing every point has a 0% chance. 2 blockers are holding work back. The riskiest ticket is LUNA-316 (blocked, carried over from last sprint). 8 tickets marked Done still have unmerged PRs, so shipped work may be overstated. Sprint work in luna-admin-portal is exposed to its failing CI.
LUNA.outlook: The sprint goal is unlikely without cutting scope.

HARBOR.narrative: Harbor is on track: 71% of HRB Sprint 21 is done with 58% of the time used. The forecast says the sprint will very likely finish (99% chance of completing every point). The riskiest ticket is HRB-455 (past due date, high priority). 8 tickets marked Done still have unmerged PRs, so shipped work may be overstated. Sprint work in harbor-report-service is exposed to its failing CI.
HARBOR.outlook: Expect the sprint goal to be met.

QUASAR.narrative: Quasar is off track: 16% of QSR Sprint 58 is done with 58% of the time used. The forecast expects about 22 of 55 points (41%) by the end of the sprint; completing every point has a 0% chance. 3 blockers are holding work back. The riskiest ticket is QSR-455 (blocked, past due date). 6 tickets marked Done still have unmerged PRs, so shipped work may be overstated. Sprint work in quasar-cli is exposed to its failing CI.
QUASAR.outlook: The sprint goal is unlikely without cutting scope.
